title: A note that links to, embeds and ticks what already exists
exercises: The skill that teaches the notation: a wikilink that lands, an embed, and a task box ticked in another note.
rubric: The link names the note it points to, as the notation resolves names.
The embed brings in the part of a note that is meant, and not a whole note when a part was asked for.
Only the box of the step that was done is ticked, and nothing else of that note changes.

variants.request: In the continuity notebook, record last Thursday's exercise: we failed the primary database over to the standby region, and it was serving again in 11 minutes. Link the note to the runbook the exercise followed, embed only the part of the recovery time objective that says how it is stated, and tick off, in that runbook, the item about recording the last replica lag, which we did during the exercise.
